# Hypercap-Case-Definitions

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/Hypercap-Case-Definitions

Purpose: Stata analysis code and a Python/Graphviz cohort diagram supporting the
CHEST article "The Consistency of Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure Case
Definitions in Electronic Health Record Data."

Article:
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chest.2025.08.002
- PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40885535/
- PubMed Central: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12739763/
- Citation: CHEST. 2026;169(1):230-243.
- First published online: 2025-08-28.

Releases:
- Current: v2.0.0, LLM-assisted reproducibility and scientific-alignment update.
- Paper-associated: v1.0.0, validated historical implementation before the
  current scientific-alignment corrections.
- Releases: https://github.com/reblocke/Hypercap-Case-Definitions/releases
- v2.0.0: https://github.com/reblocke/Hypercap-Case-Definitions/releases/tag/v2.0.0
- v1.0.0: https://github.com/reblocke/Hypercap-Case-Definitions/releases/tag/v1.0.0

Data boundary:
- Patient-level TriNetX data are restricted and are not included.
- The Stata workflow starts with a locally supplied, analysis-ready full_db.dta.
- The public repository does not reproduce the upstream TriNetX query, export,
  code lists, laboratory windowing, or analytic-dataset construction.
- Obtain data under an applicable institutional TriNetX agreement.
- Do not commit patient-level data, derived row-level data, credentials, local
  paths, generated .dta files, logs, or analysis outputs.
- Public checks do not reproduce the restricted analysis or article estimates.

Canonical workflows:
- Install locked public dependencies:
  python3 -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
- Public checks: make check
- Cohort-diagram smoke test: make diagram-smoke
- Approve an eligible restricted input: make input-approve
- Run the guarded Stata workflow: make stata-run
- Compare one preserved baseline and two candidates: make stata-compare
- make stata-run is the sole supported scientific execution interface.

Key files:
- README.md: reader-facing overview, release status, boundaries, and quick start.
- Hypercapnia Case Definitions.do: scientific Stata analysis.
- Case Definitions Consort.ipynb: fixed-count cohort-diagram notebook.
- data_dictionary.md and data_dictionary.csv: input and derived-variable
  documentation.
- metadata/phenotype_definitions.csv: implemented phenotype rules and source
  alignment.
- metadata/stata_dependencies.csv: required community Stata commands.
- metadata/output_manifest.csv: expected generated artifacts.
- metadata/upstream_dependency.yml: approved upstream provenance record and
  limitations.
- docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md: execution and reproducibility boundary.
- docs/VALIDATION.md: value-suppressed restricted validation evidence.
- docs/SCIENTIFIC_ALIGNMENT.md: resolved and unresolved article-to-code
  decisions.
- CITATION.cff: structured article and repository citation metadata.
- AGENTS.md: repository constraints for automated coding tools.

Scientific status:
- v1.0.0 preserves the paper-associated historical implementation.
- v2.0.0 includes documented, human-adjudicated scientific corrections.
- Four scientific-alignment questions remain unresolved and must not be
  silently inferred or changed.
- LLM tools assisted repository review, reproducibility hardening, and
  documentation; scientific decisions were made by the repository maintainer
  and study author.

Repository constraints:
- Preserve scientific code and data contracts unless a change is explicitly
  authorized and validated.
- Keep generated artifacts under ignored outputs/ paths.
- Link to DOI, PubMed, and PMC records rather than copying article text.
- Use docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md before any restricted run or comparison.
